Metadata.title: SecureCargo — Physics-tested cargo securement
Metadata.description: Check before the trip whether a truck's cargo is well distributed and properly secured: photo, physics simulation and a lashing plan that follows Brazilian rules.

Landing.title: SecureCargo — Physics-tested cargo securement
Landing.lead: Take a photo of the truck bed. SecureCargo simulates hard braking, curves and potholes, then shows how to place and lash the cargo so it stays put.

perceive.title: Perceive
perceive.body: A photo identifies the cargo units and the straps already in place. You confirm or edit.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.body: A physics engine runs the load through the trip: braking, cornering, potholes and road conditions.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: You get a placement and lashing plan that passes Brazilian rules and every simulated event.

App.title: SecureCargo app
App.lead: The driver flow arrives in the next phases. For now this page checks the connection to the simulation server.

errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection or try again in a moment.
errors.bad_status: The server answered with an error.
errors.bad_payload: The server answered in an unexpected format.

Footer.disclaimer: SecureCargo is a decision-support tool, not an engineering certification.
